run_auto_generate_all_docs: run the script to auto generate all Mephisto reference documentation markdown files for architects, blueprints, providers, requesters, and tasks
run_main_function: run the main function to generate all five component reference docs in one pass
generate_architect_docs: generate the architects reference markdown documentation file using the auto_generate_architect module
generate_blueprint_docs: generate the blueprints reference markdown documentation file using the auto_generate_blueprint module
generate_provider_requester_task_docs: generate the providers, requesters, and tasks reference markdown documentation files in sequence
